description: Flat input schema for the avenor_workflow tool, compiled from schemas/workflow.input.json's per-action union so an MCP client publishes one object whose property types survive: an integer stays an integer and an array stays an array. Every action's properties appear here, so a field belonging to another action is not a schema error. Per-action admission (required fields, unknown properties, types, enums and limits) belongs to the router, which answers a mismatch at once with the contract's typed invalid_request and its repair text. Generated by internal/workflowtool/cmd/genschema; do not edit.

action.description: Action to perform: status — Get lightweight status for a workflow instance; inspect — Return the full instance detail for a workflow; events — Read log events from a workflow instance's event log; wait — Wait for a workflow to reach a terminal state or until timeout; ready — Report claimable auto-dispatch candidates for a workflow controller; grants no lease; controller_status — Show workflow controller status: one controller with controller_id, or a summary list without it; gate — Record a gate decision on a parked awaiting_gate activation; complete — Atomically complete a machine/external handoff activation; cancel — Cancel a workflow instance: records the attributed cancel event, releases leases, parks non-terminal activations, and terminates in-flight attempt runtimes.

actor.description: Actor id for human gate operations. Actor id recorded as the canceling operator.

after_seq.description: Only include events with sequence greater than this value.

artifacts.description: Staged evidence artifacts as JSON, for example [{"src_path":"...","stored_path":"..."}].

controller_id.description: Controller ID. Controller ID; omit to list all controllers.

limit.description: Max events to return (0 for the server default). Max candidates to report (0 for the server default).

outcome.description: Outcome for the gate decision (used to branch reject/fail cases). Declared outcome.

outputs.description: Declared outputs as JSON, for example [{"definition_id":"o1","value":...}].

reason.description: Reason for human gate operations. Reason for the cancel; recorded on the workflow.canceled event.

subject.description: Bound exact subject as JSON, for example {"type":"pr","repository":"org/repo","pull_request":12,"revision":"abc"}.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time, such as 30s, 5m, or 1h (default 30s).

title: avenor_workflow flat input
